objective: Forecast 5-trading-day Arabica Coffee C returns and direction using local paper-inspired approaches.

paper_method_notes.npi_proxy: noncommercial_net divided by Open_Interest_All; the local abstract does not expose the exact paper formula.
paper_method_notes.per_proxy: 65-trading-day share of observations with absolute 3-year NPI z-score above 1.5; explicitly a proxy.
paper_method_notes.news_policy: Only raw GDELT event fields delayed by one calendar day are used. Future returns and derived impact scores are excluded.

leakage_audit.cot_timing: Prepared input was built from COT release dates with a three-calendar-day release lag.
leakage_audit.split_purge: Five rows are purged before validation and test so 5D targets do not cross boundaries.

split.method: chronological train/validation/test with a 5-row target purge before validation and test

volatility_metrics.note: GARCH is evaluated against future 5D realized volatility, not return direction.

regime_analysis.method: Regime thresholds are calibrated only on the initial training split. Metrics are then reported separately on validation and untouched test rows. Segments under 20 rows are omitted.
regime_analysis.warning: Regime results are diagnostic subgroup estimates, not additional tuning targets. Small segments and repeated model comparisons can make apparent winners unstable.

holdout_uncertainty.why_blocked: Daily 5D targets overlap, so ordinary independent-observation intervals are too optimistic.
holdout_uncertainty.loss_difference_interpretation: Negative values favor the named model over the zero-return baseline.

holdout_summary.selection_warning: Holdout winners are post-hoc diagnostics and were not used to tune models or ensemble weights. Use expanding-window and block-bootstrap results to judge stability.
